elena (product): Quick sync — starting a narrow initiative to finalize request/response schema conventions for our upcoming API launch. Need to lock: trace IDs, token usage fields, metadata naming, tool/function call shape, and structured output requirements. Customer asks include per-model breakdown + streaming token counts. Can we decide an MVP shape this week?

sam (eng): +1. Proposal: keep a small, predictable set of top-level fields to simplify parsing. Minimal set I like: `trace_id`, `request_id`, `model`, and flat token fields: `prompt_tokens`, `completion_tokens`, `total_tokens`. Example: 
```json
{
  "trace_id": "rwd_01ab...",
  "request_id": "req_345...",
  "model": "openLM-7b-v2",
  "prompt_tokens": 42,
  "completion_tokens": 128,
  "total_tokens": 170
}
```
Keep function calls as `tool_calls` array with minimal per-call metadata.

priya (eng-ml): Two notes: (1) streaming use-cases need incremental counts (we emit partial token deltas). Can we standardize on `partial_prompt_tokens`/`partial_completion_tokens` for stream events? (2) we should include `model_revision` or `model_hash` so customers can tie quality/regressions to exact weights.

gwen (devex): SDK impact — snake_case or camelCase? We currently have mixed usages in SDKs. If we standardize on `snake_case` server-side we can add thin client mappers for JS/TS SDKs, but that adds churn. Also need a clear deprecation/migration plan for existing fields.

matt (product): Launch criteria proposal: docs PR + example responses, SDK updates (JS+Python), migration guide + deprecation timeline, console & billing mapping for token fields, QA tests (backcompat). Also confirm privacy defaults: Private customers may want minimal telemetry by default.

sam (eng): On naming: I vote snake_case for core telemetry fields for consistency with other infra signals, e.g., `trace_id`, `request_id`, `prompt_tokens`. For function/tool outputs propose: 
```json
"tool_calls": [
  { "name": "search", "input": "q=...", "output": "...", "duration_ms": 120 }
]
```
We should avoid very deep nested objects to keep JSON parsing cheap in high-throughput clients.

priya (eng-ml): Regarding token fields: nested `token_usage` object makes schema explicit but costs parse steps for small clients. I think flat fields (`prompt_tokens`/`completion_tokens`/`total_tokens`) wins for MVP. For per-model breakdown (when serving ensembles or fallbacks) add `model_token_breakdown` as an optional array (not required for MVP). Also streaming deltas should only be emitted if client set `streaming_token_deltas=true` in request to avoid noise.

elena (product): Good alignment so far. Proposed MVP rules (short):
- adopt snake_case top-level fields: `trace_id`, `request_id`, `model`, `model_revision` (opt), `prompt_tokens`, `completion_tokens`, `total_tokens`.
- function/tool calling: `tool_calls` array with name/input/output/duration_ms/status. Keep outputs truncated by default and include full payload link only if `include_tool_payload=true` and customer consented.
- streaming: emit incremental `partial_prompt_tokens` / `partial_completion_tokens` when `streaming_token_deltas=true`.
- privacy: telemetry opt-out for Private deployments; hosted/enterprise default on but allow per-org opt-out.
- migration: 3-month deprecation window for old fields, SDK adapters for mapping camelCase -> snake_case.

gwen (devex): Launch checklist (short): docs + examples, SDK PR templates, migration guide, sample mapping script, console billing mapping, e2e tests, release notes. I'll own SDK PRs with @sam and @priya for server changes.

infra-bot: deploy-schedule: schema-helpers service will be rolled to canary on `2026-03-25` for validation only.

matt (product): One more product ask — add a small `response_meta` freeform map for customers to attach a few key/value pairs (e.g., `eval_set: "signup_flow_v2"`) so we can tie regressions to prompt/route. Keep it size-limited (256 chars per value).

elena (product): Agreed. We'll add `response_meta` (map of string->string) as optional. Make sure privacy docs reflect it. OK if everyone pushes minor PRs this week?

sam (eng): I'll open the schema PR with examples + CI validation this afternoon.

priya (eng-ml): I'll add streaming examples + per-model fields to the PR.

gwen (devex): I'll draft the SDK migration notes and a short checklist for release.

matt (product): :thumbsup:

elena (product): Great. If anything unexpected, ping #product. Thanks all.
